announcements.headline: £130,000 Share Subscription at 5.25p per Share
announcements.insight: A £130,000 share subscription at 5.25p follows the proposed acquisition and Financial Controller appointment. This capital raise supports the ongoing Direct Bullion transaction.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Financial Controller
announcements.insight: Stack BTC Plc appointed a Financial Controller following its September acquisition proposal. Shareholders should monitor if this strengthens governance for the Direct Bullion deal.

announcements.headline: Proposed acquisition of Direct Bullion
announcements.insight: Stack BTC Plc proposes acquiring Direct Bullion. This material acquisition represents a significant strategic move for shareholders to monitor.
